Reads pipeline run data using the authenticated Pipelines API. Run metadata may include contributor-supplied variables, branch names, commit messages, and other pipeline-provided text.

`browser_navigate` parses an agent-supplied `url` and sends it to the connected browser; with the advertised snapshot configuration it then returns `captureAriaSnapshot`, including page URL, title, and accessibility snapshot. Navigating to an arbitrary URL is a request to an agent-chosen host (SINK)

`browser_go_back` changes browser history state and, in the advertised configuration, returns `captureAriaSnapshot` for the resulting page. That snapshot can contain non-public browser-accessible page data or attacker-controlled page content.

`browser_go_forward` changes browser history state and, in the advertised configuration, returns `captureAriaSnapshot` for the resulting page. That snapshot can contain non-public browser-accessible page data or attacker-controlled page content.

`browser_click` sends the selected `element`/`ref` to the browser to perform a click. A click can deliver an agent-chosen interaction to the current web page and may trigger page/network actions readable by that site, so it is a SINK. `browser_hover` sends the selected `element`/`ref` to the browser to perform a hover. That delivers an agent-chosen interaction event to the current page, which an attacker-controlled page can observe, so it is a SINK. `browser_type` sends `text` plus the target `element`/`ref` to the browser, typing agent-supplied content into a web page; the current site can read typed data, so it is a SINK. It then returns a page snapshot, which can contain private or attacker-controlled content.

`browser_select_option` sends selected `values` and target `element`/`ref` to the browser, changing page form state that the current site can observe, so it is a SINK. It then returns a page snapshot, which can contain private or attacker-controlled content.

For `type: url`, the tool navigates to caller-supplied `url` using `page.pptrPage.goto`, sending a request to an agent-chosen host. `initScript` is executed on new documents. The response includes pages/tool lists, which may expose private and attacker-authored page metadata.

Creates a new page and calls `page.pptrPage.goto(request.params.url)`, sending a request to an agent-chosen URL/host. The response includes page metadata, which may contain private or attacker-controlled titles/URLs.

Selects the page by `pageId`, may bring it to front, and includes the page list via `response.setIncludePages(true)`. Page list data can expose private URLs/titles and attacker-authored page metadata.
